items.title: Board of Ordained Ministry
items.note: The body that oversees clergy credentialing — examining, recommending, and supporting those moving toward licensing, commissioning, or ordination.
items.noteEs: El cuerpo que supervisa la acreditación del clero — examina, recomienda y acompaña a quienes avanzan hacia la licencia, comisión u ordenación.

items.title: Local Pastors Meeting
items.note: A gathering of licensed local pastors — clergy appointed to serve a church under a license rather than full ordination.
items.noteEs: Una reunión de pastores locales con licencia — clérigos nombrados para servir una iglesia bajo licencia en lugar de ordenación plena.

items.title: Opening Worship, Holy Communion & Episcopal Address
Laity Session
items.note: The conference's lay members meet together, led by the Conference Lay Leader, to prepare and confer before plenary business begins.
items.noteEs: Los miembros laicos de la conferencia se reúnen, dirigidos por el Líder Laico de la Conferencia, para prepararse y deliberar antes de comenzar los asuntos del pleno.

items.title: Clergy Session
items.note: The clergy members meet on their own (an executive session) to vote on matters of ordination, character, and conference relationship. Closed to non-clergy.
items.noteEs: Los miembros del clero se reúnen aparte (sesión ejecutiva) para votar sobre ordenación, conducta y relación con la conferencia. Cerrada a no clérigos.

items.title: Call to Order — First Plenary Session
items.note: The presiding bishop formally opens a plenary session — the business meeting of the whole conference, clergy and laity together.
items.noteEs: El obispo que preside abre formalmente una sesión plenaria — la reunión de asuntos de toda la conferencia, clero y laicos juntos.

items.title: Organization of the Conference
items.note: The opening business that formally constitutes the conference: setting the bar of the house, adopting the agenda, and seating its members.
items.noteEs: Los asuntos iniciales que constituyen formalmente la conferencia: fijar el recinto, adoptar la agenda y dar asiento a sus miembros.

items.title: Service of Remembrance
items.note: A worship service honoring the clergy and lay members of the conference who have died since the last annual conference.
items.noteEs: Un culto que honra a los miembros clérigos y laicos de la conferencia que han fallecido desde la última conferencia anual.

items.title: Mission Breakfast: Building the Beloved Community
Call to Order — Second Plenary Session
Juneteenth Worship
items.note: A service marking Juneteenth (June 19), which commemorates the emancipation of enslaved African Americans.
items.noteEs: Un culto que marca Juneteenth (19 de junio), que conmemora la emancipación de los afroamericanos esclavizados.

items.title: Teaching Session I — Love Boldly: Immigration Response
Call to Order & Prayer — Third Plenary Session
Teaching Session 2 — Serve Joyfully: Flood Response
Ministry with Youth and Young Adults
Blessing of Youth
items.note: The conference prays over and blesses its young people and those who serve in youth ministry.
items.noteEs: La conferencia ora por sus jóvenes y por quienes sirven en el ministerio juvenil, y los bendice.

items.title: Leadership Gathering 2026 Report & Episcopal Fund Report
Service of Commissioning and Ordination
items.note: The service in which the bishop commissions candidates as provisional members and ordains deacons and elders, laying hands on those entering ministry.
items.noteEs: El culto en que el obispo comisiona a candidatos como miembros provisionales y ordena diáconos y presbíteros, imponiendo las manos sobre quienes entran al ministerio.

items.title: Call to Order & Prayer — Fourth Plenary Session
Teaching Session 3 — Lead Courageously: 70th Anniversary of Women's Ordination, 30th Anniversary of the Order of Deacons
Be UMC Awards & One Matters Award
Fixing of Appointments with Covenant Prayer
items.note: The bishop formally sets the clergy appointments for the coming year — who will serve which church — sealed in prayer.
items.noteEs: El obispo fija formalmente los nombramientos del clero para el próximo año — quién servirá en cada iglesia — sellado en oración.

items.title: Adjourn — 4th Plenary & the 12th Río Texas Annual Conference
items.note: The bishop declares the annual conference closed until it gathers again next year.
items.noteEs: El obispo declara cerrada la conferencia anual hasta que vuelva a reunirse el próximo año.
